subject: compiling httpuv on Solaris 10: looking for sendfile64

messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: compiling httpuv on Solaris 10: looking for sendfile64
parts:
Dear all 

Hopefully this is the right forum. If not be so kind and point me to the correct one. 
I tried to compile "httpuv". I need this for "shiny" 
The compile step stops with: 
ld.so.1: R: fatal: relocation error: file /usr/local/lib/R/library/httpuv/libs/httpuv.so: symbol sendfile64: referenced symbol not found

If I look at this so-file there is such a reference:
nm ./src/httpuv.so | grep -i sendfile64
[1304]  |         0|         0|NOTY |GLOB |0    |UNDEF  |sendfile64

But when I look at all files below the source tree there is no such string in it. 
I think the linking step is only missing an additional library, which should be linked together. 
Any ideas in which file this reference is found ? 

Kind regards
Hans

messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: Re: compiling httpuv on Solaris 10: looking for sendfile64
parts:
Hi

Thank you.
I am a step closer to the solution. 
It is the file /usr/lib/libsendfile.so I need to link.

#> nm /usr/lib/libsendfile.so | grep -i sendfile64
[30]    |      1188|       172|FUNC |LOCL |2    |8      |_sendfile64
[47]    |      1188|       172|FUNC |WEAK |0    |8      |sendfile64

Therefore I should add anywhere a  -lsendfile  to a Makefile. But where.
Till now without success. 
It seems this is not one of the Makefiles's of the httpuv source-tree. It must be anywhere else.

Any help would be nice. 


Kind regards 
Hans
